subject: Supply-chain human-rights onboarding & PO setup
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@novafelix.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novafelix.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro — supplier intake & human-rights questionnaire

Hi Marcus —

Thanks for the quick intro. We’re excited to move forward with Redwood as a potential inference partner. To get the vendor setup started on our side I need the following from you so we can complete our vendor intake and make sure PO/invoice routing is correct:

- Redwood supplier intake form (legal name, tax ID, bank wiring instructions)
- Any modern-slavery / human-rights questionnaire you require during onboarding
- Sustainability or supplier diversity self‑ID forms if available
- Process note: do you require a signed PO prior to first invoice, or can we invoice on receipt?

I’ve attached our initial supplier profile (NovaFelix_Supplier_Profile.pdf) and can share any additional docs if helpful. Our target is to complete onboarding this week so payments can start in early July.

Best,
Elena Soto
Head of Procurement
NovaFelix Logistics

[Attachment: NovaFelix_Supplier_Profile.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@novafelix.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Intro — supplier intake & human-rights questionnaire

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and for sending the profile. Looping in Lauren (Finance ops) and Monica (Vendor success) to cover tax/W-9 and onboarding assistance.

Action items from our side:
1) I’m attaching the Redwood Supplier Intake Form — please complete sections A–D and return (bank details go in section C).
2) Please complete the Redwood Modern Slavery & Human Rights Questionnaire — short, 6 questions — we use this for supply-chain risk screening.
3) If you’d like, also fill the Sustainability Snapshot (optional) and Supplier Diversity self‑ID so we can flag any diversity programs.
4) Once forms are submitted, Lauren will open a vendor file and confirm PO requirements.

Timeline: if we get completed forms back by 06/25 we can usually issue a PO and set up net30 payment terms for the first invoice. If you need earlier payment we have a one-off expedited-payments workflow but that needs finance approval.

Links: Redwood onboarding checklist: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/Onboarding-Checklist
HubSpot deal for reference: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/4621

Attachments: redwood_supplier_intake_form.docx, redwood_modern_slavery_questionnaire.pdf, sustainability_snapshot.xlsx

Thanks — small ask: include a point of contact for accounts payable and a remit-to email.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood_supplier_intake_form.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@novafelix.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novafelix.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 08:16:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Intro — supplier intake & human-rights questionnaire

Marcus / team —

Appreciate the clear checklist. Quick answers and next steps: 

- We can complete the intake form and the modern-slavery questionnaire by end of day 06/25.
- AP contact: AP Ops <apops@novafelix.com>, remit-to: payments@novafelix.com
- We typically require a PO number on the invoice for internal allocation. Will Redwood issue a PO before first invoice?
- Attaching our payroll/company registration cert for your records.

We’ll return the completed forms as Word/PDF to procurement@redwood.com. If there’s a preferred secure upload or DocuSign route let us know.

Thanks,
Elena

[Attachment: NovaFelix_Company_Cert.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@novafelix.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 14:08:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Intro — supplier intake & human-rights questionnaire

Elena — thanks and great to meet you. Short answers from finance:

- Yes, Redwood normally issues a PO prior to the first invoice for vendor setups tied to active deals. We can open a PO once we have the completed intake form and tax docs.
- Please send completed forms and remit/bank details to procurement@redwood.com. For bank wiring we require the completed intake form plus a bank letter or voided check (section C).
- Net terms: we’ll target Net30 from invoice receipt. If you need earlier payment, indicate that on the intake form and mark it as "expedite" — Monica will route that for approval.
- Security/compliance: if we need a deeper security or SOC2 questionnaire we’ll request it after basic onboarding; Monica will coordinate scheduling with your team if needed.

Next steps:
1) NovaFelix returns redwood_supplier_intake_form.docx + modern slavery questionnaire by 06/25
2) Finance issues PO (PO number provided via email)
3) Vendor file created and vendor code shared

If you prefer DocuSign for signatures, let Monica know and we’ll send the package.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Manager, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

[Signature block omitted for brevity]
